subject: Cloud app catalog onramp: listing prerequisites & technical gating
messages:
From: Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.io>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: partners@cloudbridge.io
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cloud app catalog onramp: listing prerequisites & technical gating

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for taking this. We're starting the catalog onramp for CloudBridge partners and wanted to surface a few technical + governance asks so we can scope the listing window. Attached is our partner requirements doc (cloudbridge_list_requirements.docx) but key items for Redwood: 

- Entitlement mapping: how your product will present SKU/plan metadata and whether we can pull entitlement state via an API call (read-only).
- SSO and account linking: we need a recommended SAML/OIDC flow and a sandbox to validate SSO attributes (email, org_id).
- Billing hooks: minimal webhook contract for metering events (token_count, usage_period).
- Telemetry and logs: basic runtime telemetry surface (latency p50/p95, error-rate) and an option to receive anonymized usage samples for QA.

We are aiming to list Redwood in the CloudBridge app catalog by end of Q1. Can you confirm which of these are blockers vs. items we can mark as "post-listing work"? Also want to confirm if you can support our test accounts for SSO next week.

Happy to do a 30-min sync — suggest Tue or Wed morning PT.

Thanks,
Raj
Partnerships, CloudBridge

Attachment: cloudbridge_list_requirements.docx
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Raj Patel <raj@cloudbridge.io>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@lauren_bishop>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud app catalog onramp: listing prerequisites & technical gating

Raj —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick response below and then I think a short sync to align scope is the right next step. High-level: we can ship a minimal listing with an entitlement shim and webhook contract, but a few items will need product prioritization or a temporary exception (see notes).

Immediate notes: 
- Entitlement mapping: we have an API that can return plan_id and active flag for a customer; we'd be able to expose a read-only endpoint for CloudBridge but we'll need to scope auth model.
- SSO & sandbox: we can provide a staging SAML endpoint and test orgs; need your SP metadata.
- Billing hooks: partner webhook prototype exists but it omits token-level granularity today; can provide aggregated usage events (daily).
- Telemetry: we can surface p50/p95; sending anonymized usage samples will require a short legal review and opt-in.

Action items I propose before the sync: 
1) Ben, can you validate the webhook payload and list any additional fields CloudBridge will need? (see attached redwood_onramp_checklist.pdf)
2) Karthik, confirm whether a temporary "aggregated usage" listing is acceptable to Product for an initial go-live.
3) Raj, please share SP metadata and a handful of test accounts for SSO validation.

Slot suggestions: Tue 11/10 9:30am PT or Wed 11/11 10:00am PT.

Thanks,
Vanessa
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood_onramp_checklist.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 9 Nov 2026 14:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud app catalog onramp: listing prerequisites & technical gating

Thanks Vanessa and Raj — looping in technical details from our side. Short answers and a recommended minimal contract below.

1) Webhook / Billing hooks - Recommended minimal event: { event_type: "usage.aggregated", period_start, period_end, total_tokens, customer_id, plan_id } - We can publish daily aggregated events today; token-level streaming is on the backlog.

2) Entitlement API - Endpoint: GET /partner/v1/entitlements?customer_id=<id> returns plan_id + active boolean + expires_at. We'll scope an API key model for CloudBridge (read-only).

3) SSO - We support SAML SP metadata upload in staging. We need the full attribute map; email and org_id are standard.

4) Telemetry hooks - We'll provide p50/p95 and 5xx-rate via a partner metrics endpoint. Sending sample payloads or spans requires opt-in and a short compliance checklist.

Action items (owner):
- Ben: draft webhook sample payload and an example server verification token (today). Attachment: connector_schema_v0.2.json
- Karthik: decide on product-level tolerance for aggregated billing for initial listing.
- Vanessa: confirm sync slot and share the CloudBridge SP metadata + test accounts.

If CloudBridge needs token-level billing for their catalog, we can evaluate a special contract but that will add ~8-10 weeks. For a Q1 listing I recommend accepting aggregated daily usage and scheduling the detailed telemetry + token-level billing as Phase 2.

Ben Carter
Principal Partner Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachment: connector_schema_v0.2.json

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2026 09:00:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Cloud app catalog onramp: listing prerequisites & technical gating

Folks —

Thanks for the notes. Product constraints and recommendation below. TL;DR: we can support an initial listing with the aggregated usage model and a scoped entitlement API, but two governance items must be cleared first: legal opt-in for telemetry samples and a short SLA/uptime commitment for the partner endpoint we expose.

Notes:
- Roadmap windows: engineering can deliver the entitlement read endpoint + webhook prototype for partners in ~6 weeks if we prioritize now; full token-level billing is a Q2 initiative unless CloudBridge funds an expedited path.
- Exceptions: we can use our internal exemption process for listing with aggregated billing and telemetry opt-in. Vanessa — please submit an exemption request with the business case (expected ARR, strategic rationale).
- Security: if CloudBridge needs access to sample payloads, Security will require an approved data-minimization checklist and a signed DPA amendment.

I recommend the sync focus on: 1) confirming SSO test metadata + schedule; 2) sign-off on aggregated billing for go-live; 3) timeline for Phase 2 token-billing.

Karthik Iyer
VP Product, Redwood Inference

Attachment: exemption-template.docx
